description: This file contains a JUnit test class ClientResourceTest that tests REST API endpoints related to client management in a CRM application using RestAssured.

classes.name: ClientResourceTest
classes.description: Test class for testing client-related REST API endpoints using Spring Boot and RestAssured.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes RestAssured port before each test.

methods.name: should_return_created_user

methods.description: Returns the API endpoint for retrieving client by ID.
